description: Protected and conserved lands in the United States compiled by The Trust for Public Land (TPL) Conservation Almanac. Includes fee-owned lands, conservation easements, and other protected areas with ownership, management, access, and funding program attributes.
title: TPL Conservation Almanac 2024

almanac-parquet.title: GeoParquet
almanac-parquet.description: Cloud-optimized GeoParquet with MULTIPOLYGON geometries, 90,068 features

almanac-pmtiles.title: PMTiles
almanac-pmtiles.description: Vector tiles for web map visualization

almanac-hex.title: H3 Hex Parquet
almanac-hex.description: H3 hexagonal tiling at resolution 10 with parent resolutions 9, 8, 0. Hive-partitioned by h0 cell.

table:columns.name: fid
table:columns.description: Row identifier from source data. Not guaranteed unique — use tpl_id to identify distinct conservation sites.

table:columns.name: tpl_id
table:columns.description: TPL site identifier. Uniquely identifies a conservation area. A single site can have multiple rows (one per funding program/sponsor), all sharing the same tpl_id. Use COUNT(DISTINCT tpl_id) to count conservation sites; use COUNT(*) to count funding transactions.

table:columns.name: acres
table:columns.description: Area in acres of the conservation site. Repeated across all funding rows for the same site — use with DISTINCT tpl_id to avoid double-counting.

table:columns.name: owner_type
table:columns.description: Owner type (Federal, State, Local, Non-profit, Private, etc.)

table:columns.name: amount
table:columns.description: Funding amount in dollars for this transaction (one row = one funder). SUM(amount) across all rows for a site gives total funding from all sources.

table:columns.name: program
table:columns.description: Funding program name (e.g. 'State Bonds - Proposition 50', 'Land and Water Conservation Fund'). One site may have multiple programs.
